IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Hunter, Carlyle, Hurst, Wylie, Ryu, Morrell, and Pollet

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating greater consistency in the regulatory schemes applied to marijuana during the transition to the implementation of Initiative Measure No. 502.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating greater consistency in the regulatoryschemes applied to marijuana during the transition to theimplementation of Initiative Measure No. 502; adding a new chapter toTitle 82 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided otherwise insubsection (2) of this section, in addition to any other taxes, thereis levied and collected from every person for the privilege of engagingwithin this state in a business operating pursuant to chapter 69.51ARCW as a medical cannabis dispensary a marijuana excise tax equal totwentyfive percent of the gross proceeds of sales of useable cannabisand cannabisinfused products. (2) Pharmacies licensed by the department of health under chapter18.64 RCW are exempt from the tax levied in this section. (3)(a) The taxes levied under this section must be paid to thedepartment in accordance with RCW 82.32.045. (b) All other applicable provisions of chapter 82.32 RCW have fullforce and application with respect to the tax imposed under thissection. The department must administer this section. p. 1 HB 1789 (4) Taxes collected under this section must be deposited in thededicated marijuana fund created in RCW 69.50.530. (5) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thischapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Cannabis" has the same meaning as provided for "marijuana" inRCW 69.50.101. (b) "Cannabisinfused products" has the same meaning as providedfor "marijuanainfused products" in RCW 69.50.101. (c) "Gross proceeds of sales" has the same meaning as in RCW82.04.070. (d) "Medical cannabis dispensary" means any business, person, orentity that engages in the sale or delivery of marijuana to anotherperson pursuant to chapter 69.51A RCW in return for money or othervaluable consideration, or who is otherwise licensed to conduct retailsales of medical cannabis under chapter 69.51A RCW.
Section 1 of this act constitutes a newchapter in Title 82 RCW.
